section.content: 本申请提供了一种锂离子电池组，包括壳体、支架和多个电芯。所述壳体包括顶部盖板、底部垫板和多个依次首尾连接的壁板。在每一个所述壁板开设有窗口门，以使所述电芯通过所述窗口门自由出入所述壳体。本申请提供的锂离子电池组结构，一方面，在锂离子电池组的壳体内设置支架，将壳体内的收纳空间分隔为多个分部独立密闭的子收纳空间，大大减小了在热失控发生时锂离子电池组内部电解液反应的体积，大大降低了电解液反应速率，从而遏止了热失控的进一步发展；另一方面，在所述壳体的壁板上，开设有窗口门，锂离子电池组内的电芯可在热失控发生时，通过所述窗口门将所述电芯移出所述壳体，有效阻止锂离子电池组内部进一步产生剧烈的化学反应。

Li-ion batteries pilesTechnical field

This application involves technical field of lithium ion, more particularly to a kind of Li-ion batteries piles.

Background technique

In recent years, the market share of electric car is promoted steadily.There is lithium ion battery high voltage, high-energy-density, length to follow The excellent performances such as ring service life and no pollution to the environment, the highest attention by ev industry.However, lithium ion battery heat is lost Burning mixture, such as H can be generated during control2, CO or CH4Deng accumulating in inside battery.Reach in inside lithium ion cell After certain pressure boundary, safety valve is washed open by burning mixture, is discharged into external environment as battery erupts.In battery In ejection process, surface temperature of lithium ion battery can reach 1000 DEG C or so, and lithium ion battery cell internal temperature is higher, It is usually associated with Mars, surface temperature is about 600~1200 DEG C or so.Due to the high temperature surface of lithium ion battery and fire Star temperature is much higher than the ignition temperature of gaseous state eruption, once the injection of gaseous state eruption contacts in air and with oxygen, by pole Easily there is Ignition Phenomena, and causes fire.In addition, even if the gaseous state eruption generated after lithium ion battery eruption does not catch fire Phenomenon will likely also will appear explosion phenomenon if gradually running up to certain amount, and harmfulness will be bigger.Therefore, lithium ion Battery eruption is to cause one of the security risk of lithium-ion electric Pool fire even explosion accident.Lithium ion battery thermal runaway causes Fire and explosion accident appear in the newspapers repeatly, the safety issue that lithium ion battery uses, which becomes, hinders that it is big in electrical source of power industry One of the principal element of scale commercialization application.

Lithium ion battery thermal runaway process is made of series of chemical.In traditional scheme, due to lithium ion The limitation of this body structure of battery only changes the stability of lithium ion battery material, Wu Fazhi in the lithium ion battery design phase Connect and the chemical reaction boundary inside lithium-ion battery monomer controlled, also can not effectively control thermal runaway process generation and The problem of development process.
